editorialNotes: Visva-Bharati’s founder biography and Banglapedia were read with the Academy of American Poets profile; the Nobel biography was checked through indexed text but direct access returned HTTP 403.

Visva-Bharati dates Sriniketan to 1922. The American Poets profile’s relative phrase “six years later” after 1919 is inconsistent; it was not used to date the new entry. Banglapedia independently supports the rural reconstruction programme.
The English Gitanjali is a selection containing poems from more than the Bengali volume of that name; the existing text does not imply identical contents.
The anthem fact describes subsequent reception of songs he created. India and Bangladesh’s adoption is not entered as an event performed by him after his 1941 death.
No new life event beyond 1941 was identified or invented. The selective account does not claim to exhaust his travels, painting, songs or bibliography.
This is an AI editorial and translation review; no human or native-speaker certification is asserted.
The existing stable item IDs, life status and rating fields are preserved. No influence rating is added. The chronology is selective, not a complete daily record.

translationReview.method: Existing validated canonical snapshots were checked before edits. Seven explicitly scoped delta exports/imports were reviewed; changed units were translated and checked by AI, shared facts were checked, and unchanged strings were reused. No hashes were edited directly.
